title: The gate, 1994, open
logline: The mill gate in 1994, open for the morning shift: log trucks coming in, men walking in with pails, the stack already smoking. Everything the padlock page will close. Era I spotting.

panels.composition: A chain-link mill gate standing open at dawn with a log truck rolling in and a line of men walking in with lunch pails, the stack smoking beyond, black spotting in the tire ruts.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a chain-link mill gate standing open at dawn with a log truck rolling in and a line of men walking in carrying lunch pails, a brick stack smoking beyond, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
